subject: BluePilot renewal: capacity & ROI check
messages:
From: Samira Khan <samira@bluepilot.ai>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-02-23T10:15:00-08:00
Subject: Q1 renewal: usage & capacity check — BluePilot

Evelyn,

Hope you’re well — our renewal is coming up in May and we wanted to get ahead of capacity planning. Over the past 6 weeks we rolled out a recommender feature that increased generation traffic ~2.3x during peak hours. We expect that pattern to continue as we onboard two new enterprise partners in April.

Quick asks:
- Can you send a brief token spend and latency ROI recap for the past quarter (Q1)? We need something the procurement team can digest.
- We may need to increase our committed capacity for the term to avoid rate throttling. What would a 1.5x and 2x commit look like economically for 12- and 24-month terms?
- Any recommendations for preserving latency SLOs while lowering unit cost (batching/quantization suggestions)?

Alan (cc’d) is our head of ops and will be on the procurement call. Can we book a 30-min sync next week? Ideally we’d have the usage/ROI PDF before the call so our CFO can review in advance.

Thanks — appreciate the partnership.

—Samira
Head of Product, BluePilot

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira@bluepilot.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-02-24T09:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Q1 renewal: usage & capacity check — BluePilot

Samira — thanks for the heads-up and congrats on the recommender rollout. We ran a preliminary analysis and I’ve attached two artifacts: bluepilot_q1_usage_report.csv (token breakdown by route + hour) and latency_report_q1.pdf (p95/p99 by model variant). High level:

- Q1 token spend: 1.9M input tokens / 7.8M output tokens (total 9.7M). Monthly run-rate trending +45% vs Q4.
- Cost profile: average per-1k tokens $0.62 on current plan; we can get to ~$0.49 with a 1.5x commit + quantized v2 model variants for non-latency-sensitive routes.
- Latency: p95 is 320ms on current hosted route; with batching we see p95 rise for small requests but p99 stays within your SLO with prefix caching enabled.

Proposed next steps:
1) Quick 30-min call — I’m available Tue/Thu next week 9–11am PT.
2) I’ll run commit scenarios and loop Ben + Priya for pricing and amendment drafting.
3) Share an amendment draft + DocuSign link within two weeks.

Suggested times: Tue 2027-03-02 10:00am PT or Thu 2027-03-04 9:30am PT — let me know what works for Alan/CFO.

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Attachment: bluepilot_q1_usage_report.csv (token breakout), latency_report_q1.pdf (latency curves)

Ben / Priya — forwarding Samira’s note and the usage artifacts. Key context: BluePilot saw a 2.3x peak traffic lift and is projecting continued growth with two partner integrations. They want: token/ROI recap, commit scenarios for 1.5x and 2x (12/24 months), and latency-preserving cost recommendations.

My read: good upsell motion — probability high for a 12-month commit at 1.5x to start. They care about price transparency and a quick signature window (2 weeks).

Please advise:
- Pricing: what discount tiers do we show for 12m / 24m at 1.5x and 2x? Include committed per-1k token price and total monthly charge example.
- Operational: any suggested guardrails (burst pool, canary routes, fallback to quantized variant) to include in the amendment?
- Legal/Proc: we may need a short amendment for term + commit + billing cadence. Can you prepare proposed_commit_sheet.xlsx and a lean amendment draft?

I’ve attached the usage/latency artifacts and started a spreadsheet with baseline numbers. Keep replies tight — they want a CFO-ready summary.

Thanks — Evelyn

Attachment: proposed_commit_sheet.xlsx (placeholder — please update)

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira@bluepilot.ai>, Alan Reyes <alan@bluepilot.ai>, contracts@bluepilot.ai
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-03-11T15:42:00-07:00
Subject: BluePilot renewal: capacity & ROI check — proposal and next steps

Samira / Alan — thanks for the call today. Per our conversation, summary and next steps below:

Summary (Q1 baseline):
- Current monthly run-rate: ~3.2M tokens (avg). Q1 total: 9.7M tokens.
- Recommended commit to avoid throttling: start with 1.5x current committed baseline (gives ~1.7x headroom on projected traffic).
- Pricing options (per-1k tokens):
  • 12-month, 1.5x commit — $0.50/1k (effective ~19% discount vs current)
  • 24-month, 1.5x commit — $0.45/1k + extended pricing protections
  • 12-month, 2x commit — $0.43/1k (larger uplift required)

Operational recommendations:
- Enable prefix/KV caching on high-frequency routes (low latency overhead, large unit savings).
- Route non-interactive batches to quantized v2 variants; keep low-latency interactive routes on full-precision.
- Configure a burst pool (5–10% of committed capacity) for new partner onboarding windows; automatic fallback to hosted low-cost variant if burst exhausted.

Legal & billing:
- We drafted a short amendment that adds the commit schedule, billing cadence, and a 30-day notice for adjustments. Draft attached (bluepilot_amendment_draft.pdf).
- DocuSign link will be sent once you confirm the pricing option and term.

Proposed immediate next steps:
1) Please confirm whether you want to proceed with the 12-month 1.5x option. If yes, we’ll send DocuSign with the amendment and target a signing window of 10 business days.
2) If you prefer a 24-month rate, let us know and we’ll update the amendment with extended protections.
3) Technical kickoff with our Solutions team arranged for the week after sign (I’ll loop Marissa to schedule).

I’ve attached the amendment draft and the commit workbook for your review. Happy to adjust numbers if procurement wants alternate structures (monthly true-up, tiered overage).

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Attachments: bluepilot_amendment_draft.pdf, proposed_commit_sheet.xlsx
